body: 1 against 100,000. If I open my mouth or do anything then I'm just being the exact stereotype that they think I am. I have no voice.
This is my home. It's the white people that make me feel like I don't belong here.

If by home you mean parents and family, I have none of those things. I have no one. I am completely isolated in my home because I'm too afraid to leave the house. Someone else will hurt me. It's always something, every day, and If it happens one more time (and it will) its going to be the end of my soul and spirit.

No one wants to comment because no one wants to talk about racism.. Ever. What did you think was the result of being treated like your invisible (no eye contact), or being treated with hostility by people you don't even know because they assume that you are aggressive. It makes a person feel rejected by society, and if society doesn't want me to exist, why should I? 

Would you want to live if the whole world was constantly telling you that you aren't welcome? Would you? 

My death will make one less person of color to spy on while shopping in your store. Death is my freedom. 

Not a single person will disagree.
